text: Fill in the correct spinal nerve level for each dermatome landmark.
questions: The thumb is supplied by the *C6/C 6:This lies on the lateral (preaxial) border of the upper limb.* dermatome.
The nipple lies at the level of the *T4/T 4:A key chest wall landmark for spinal block assessment.* dermatome.
The umbilicus lies at the level of the *T10/T 10:The most tested abdominal dermatome landmark.* dermatome.
The middle finger is supplied by the *C7/C 7:The longest finger, in the middle of the hand.* dermatome.
The lateral border of the foot is supplied by the *S1/S 1:This level is also tested by the ankle jerk reflex.* dermatome.

overallFeedback.feedback: These dermatome landmarks (C6 thumb, C7 middle finger, T4 nipple, T10 umbilicus, S1 lateral foot) are used daily to assess the level of spinal cord lesions, determine the height of spinal anaesthesia, and predict which dermatome a shingles rash will follow.
